placements.why: The content centers on instrument calibration work — establishing, verifying, and ratifying a spectrograph's calibration — which names an organizational category nothing in the existing (empty) strata covers.
placements.title: Instrument Calibration as Verifiable Organizational Practice
placements.frame: How does the organization establish, verify, and ratify instrument calibration against reference standards?

placements.title: From Uncalibrated to Verified Across the Band
placements.frame: What does it take to establish and ratify an instrument's calibration against established reference standards?
placements.why: All three expressions perform the establishment and verification of the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration — from status announcement through reference-plate verification to formal ratification — a thematic subject future envelopes will keep feeding.
